ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey to black) surface with approximately 15% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixel coverage localized in linear streaks and focal clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-intensity regions cover the majority of both lobes; high-contrast light grey linear streaks are concentrated in the mid-left quadrant and adjacent to the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 55 degrees and a high depth-to-span ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude variations along the entire trailing boundary, characterized by numerous fine-scale peaks and a macro-scale irregular protrusion on the distal left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep trajectory originating from the notch and extending to the distal tips, terminating in a tapered point on the right and an irregular, blunt mass on the left.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, textured pixel clusters with roughly circular topography concentrated on the extreme distal margin and trailing edge of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of distinct, unaligned light-intensity linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) appearing as parallel and intersecting vertical/diagonal marks across the central-left fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant morphological irregularity on the distal upper margin of the left lobe, featuring an atypical bulbous protrusion and concentrated crustose texture.
